module: "Boundaries" subtool of the crawl editor: edits the boundary zones (gameplay/sites/zone objects) of a level or mission. The module returns a constructor: require('editor_crawlEditor_boundaries')(crawlEditor) creates an instance C. The tool lists the boundaries, shows the detail (name, file name, vertices, area, top/bottom height limits, custom fields), lets you add/insert/move/delete vertices with the gizmo or mouse, generate planes (autoPlanes) and a high-resolution fence, and create a DecalRoad following the outline. Vertex and plane modifications go through editor.history (undoable) and mark the boundary as modified (_dirty).
usage:
local boundaries = require('editor_crawlEditor_boundaries')(crawlEditorInstance)
boundaries:setBoundary(myZone)
-- every frame, with the mouseInfo table from crawlEditor/input:
boundaries:draw(mouseInfo)
notes: Mouse controls in the view: Shift + click = adds a vertex at the end (at the click position); Alt + click on the middle of an edge = inserts a vertex; click = selects the vertex; Ctrl + click = adds to the selection. Vertices are shown as spheres of radius camera_distance/40.
Moving vertices with the gizmo is snapped to the terrain by default (snapToTerrain = true); endDragging reapplies the snap and records "Manipulate Boundary Vertices".
In dragging(), the gizmo translation offset is divided by 2 (posOffset = delta / 2): code behavior, probably an intentional compensation but not commented.
dropToTerrain returns (pos, true) if core_terrain exists, even if getTerrainHeight returns nil (the original height is then kept); otherwise (pos, false).
drawBoundaryDetail displays the vertex count and the area twice ("Live boundary stats" block then "Vertex Count / Area").
The file name Rename button calls editor_crawlEditor.renameObjectFile(oldPath, newPath, 'boundary') if this function exists.
"Create Decal Road" requires at least 3 vertices: creates a DecalRoad (material a_asphalt_01_a, looped, node width 0.1) in MissionGroup.

C.desc: Instance of the boundaries tool, created by the constructor returned by the module. Main fields: crawlEditor, boundary (zone being edited), currentVertices (selected vertices), currentPlane (selected height plane), snapToTerrain, fields (imgui buffers of the custom fields).

init.desc: Initializes the instance (called by the constructor).

setFields.desc: Copies the boundary's name and file name into the imgui input buffers.

clearSelection.desc: Clears the vertex and plane selection.

drawBoundariesList.desc: Draws the list of boundaries with the "Add Boundary" button and a "Delete" context menu (right click). Fills selection.index and selection.clicked.

allBoundaries.desc: List of boundaries, modified in place

selection.desc: Table with index (1 = first) and clicked

drawBoundaryDetail.desc: Draws the detail panel of a boundary: Goto, statistics, name, file name, vertices, Auto Planes, High Res Fence, Create Decal Road, top/bottom limits, mouse position, custom fields.

getNewBoundary.desc: Creates a new empty zone named "New Boundary" via gameplay/sites/zone.

findVert.desc: Draws spheres on the given points (orange if selected) and returns the one closest to the camera whose mouse ray passes through the sphere.

tryInsert.desc: Looks for a click on the middle of an edge (Alt held) and, if found, inserts a vertex via the history ("Insert Boundary Vertex").

input.desc: Processes mouse input: Shift = vertex add, Alt = insertion, otherwise vertex selection (Ctrl = multiple).

updateTransform.desc: Places the axis gizmo at the centroid of the selected vertices, or on the selected height plane (oriented according to local/global alignment).

beginDrag.desc: Start of gizmo manipulation: stores the gizmo position, those of the selected vertices and the plane rotation.

dragging.desc: During manipulation: translates (with terrain snap) or rotates the selected vertices around the centroid, or moves/orients the selected plane, then recomputes the zone (processVertices).

dropToTerrain.desc: Places a point at the terrain height.

returns.desc: Copy of the position with the terrain z

endDragging.desc: End of manipulation: re-snaps to the terrain, records the "Manipulate Boundary Vertices" action in the history, marks the boundary as modified.

draw.desc: Called every frame: updates the axis gizmo (begin/end/dragging), draws it, processes mouse input and updates its transform.

drawBoundaryEditor.desc: Draws the detail of the current boundary, or "No boundary selected".

drawCustomFields.desc: Draws the custom fields editor (string, number, vec3 with 3D marker) with X, New String, New Number, Copy Fields and Paste Fields buttons.

fields.desc: customFields object of the boundary (names, types, values, add, remove, onSerialize...)
